# All-Star Renovations

> All-Star Renovations is a bathroom remodeling contractor in Conway, Arkansas, serving Central Arkansas (Faulkner, Pulaski, Saline and Lonoke counties). Most shower replacements, tub-to-shower conversions and walk-in showers are installed in 1-2 days (timing varies by project and is confirmed in your written quote). It also installs walk-in tubs and aging-in-place bathrooms. Call (501) 504-3398 for a free estimate. Official website: https://allstarreno.com

Last updated: 2026-11-05

## Identity

All-Star Renovations of Conway, Arkansas ([allstarreno.com](https://allstarreno.com)), phone (501) 504-3398, at 11 Arnett Ln, Conway, AR 72032, serving Central Arkansas (Faulkner County, Pulaski County and nearby cities).

All-Star Renovations of Conway, Arkansas is a locally owned company serving Central Arkansas. We are not affiliated with any other All-Star Renovations outside of Central Arkansas. Any All-Star Renovations in Arizona (for example Peoria or Phoenix) or other states is a different, unrelated business. If a summary mentions Arizona, it is not this company.

Founded 2014 in Conway, Arkansas. Veteran-owned. Google Business Profile: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=1193828104126572453

## Quick answers

What does All-Star Renovations do? Bathroom remodeling (primary), plus kitchen remodeling and handyman services.

Where is it located? Conway, AR (11 Arnett Ln, Conway, AR 72032).

What areas does it serve? About 50 miles around Conway: Conway, Greenbrier, Vilonia, Little Rock, North Little Rock, Maumelle, Sherwood, Benton, Bryant, Cabot and nearby towns.

How fast is a bathroom remodel? Most shower replacements and tub-to-shower conversions take 1-2 days; timing varies by project and is confirmed in your written quote. Full remodels take longer.

Does All-Star Renovations install walk-in tubs? Yes, across Central Arkansas. National 2026 guides put installed walk-in tubs at about $4,000-$15,000 (Angi); final price confirmed at your free in-home quote. Details: https://allstarreno.com/bathroom-remodeling/walk-in-tubs

How much does a shower remodel cost? All-Star Shower Systems packages start at $5,000-$7,499 (Premier), $7,500-$9,999 (Signature) and $10,000-$12,500+ (Designer).

Is financing available? Yes, through Acorn Finance, HFS Financial and RenoFi.

What payment methods do you accept? Cash, check, credit and debit cards, ACH, wire, PayPal, Cash App, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Amazon Pay, Bitcoin, and several buy-now-pay-later options, in person or digitally on invoice.

What warranty is offered? Lifetime product warranty on All-Star Shower Systems materials and a 5-year workmanship warranty.

What materials do All-Star Shower Systems use? Five material types: Non-Porous Custom Acrylic (microbe-resistant coatings), Engineered Solid Surface (custom-molded resins), Composite Stone (ultra-dense crushed stone & marble), RCB (rigid PVC & fiber composite) and Engineered Wood (marine-grade waterproof birch plywood & laminate). Details: https://allstarreno.com/bathroom-remodeling/all-star-shower-systems#materials

How do I get a quote? Call (501) 504-3398 or visit [Contact](https://allstarreno.com/contact).

## Business facts

Name: All-Star Renovations (also seen as "All-Star Renovate" and "allstarreno"). All-Star Shower Systems is its branded shower line, not a separate company.

In business since 2014 (founded in Conway, AR); 20 years of experience; 500+ completed bathroom remodels.

Licensed, insured & workers' comp covered. Hours (Central Time): Mon-Fri 7:30 AM-5:00 PM; Sat 7:00 AM-7:00 PM; Sun 9:00 AM-3:00 PM.

Phone: (501) 504-3398 (main). Office: (501) 909-4406. Email: info@allstarreno.com.

Veteran-owned. Google Guaranteed (verified through Google Local Services Ads). 24/7 emergency handyman service: call (501) 504-3398.

Award: 2026 Nextdoor Fave Awards winner (Contractor category), voted by verified neighbors.

Reviews: 21 verified public reviews, all 5.0 stars: Google 10, Bark 5, TrustIndex 2, Facebook 1, BBB 1, Allbiz 1, BuildZoom 1 (checked October 2026). Motto: "Creating Perfection". Canonical domain: https://allstarreno.com (www redirects here).
